summary: EVAVO's provider-neutral agent routing, specialist MCP federation, zero-cost worker admission, remote relay and governed Codex worker transport authority. It selects and executes only typed, source-bound operations and does not inherit repository publication authority.

capabilities.title: Plan provider-neutral capability routes
capabilities.description: Select the narrowest fresh eligible specialist, local execution, worker or fixed relay route from typed capability and transport evidence without granting the selected route additional authority.

capabilities.title: Route governed Windows execution
capabilities.description: Route structured workstation work to Local Compute, Local Storage or another typed specialist using exact source, task and receipt contracts. The route itself is not an unrestricted shell and does not prove physical completion.
requires: Fresh Local Compute or Local Storage acceptance

capabilities.title: Assemble canonical Spark capacity and admission status
capabilities.description: Keep raw included-plan capacity, Codex capability, supervised physical acceptance and short-lived route admission as separate digest-bound evidence classes before any worker selection.

capabilities.title: Run the contained Codex Test Builder
capabilities.description: Compile a contained exact-bound dispatch, run one test-generation-only Codex worker in an isolated candidate worktree at concurrency one, prove zero ignored workspace files before and after the model turn, and independently bind the exact patch, changed-file bytes and Git index into a pre-validation completion receipt. Paid fallback, provider overrides, staging, commit, publication and deterministic-validation authority remain forbidden.
requires: Zero ignored files at dispatch, process boundaries and completion
Final contained dispatch and run receipts

capabilities.title: Expose bounded remote status and typed dispatch
capabilities.description: Provide read-only remote MCP status plus a separately authenticated fixed-action relay without exposing a public arbitrary command endpoint or treating queue acceptance as execution.
requires: Correlated physical receipt for completion claims

capabilities.title: Observe and route the GitHub repository estate
capabilities.description: Compile immutable repository and source evidence for capability routing and governance without inferring write, publication or deployment authority from repository visibility.

topics: Codex Test Builder contained exact-bound execution
